package domain

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestValidateDiagnosticPlanRecordRejectsGoalDirectionDigestRevisionCreatedAtIDempotencyAndHashCorruption(t *testing.T) {
	created := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	b := DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{GoalCode: "go.backend", DirectionCode: "backend", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", BindingRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, Active: true, CreatedAt: created}
	b.BindingDigest, _ = DiagnosticBootstrapBindingDigest(b)
	p := DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{Schema: DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchemaV1, ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: b.CourseID, PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: DiagnosticFixedPolicyV1, OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", CourseRevision: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", CreatedAt: created}
	for n := 0; n < 3; n++ {
		p.Assessments = append(p.Assessments, DiagnosticAssessment{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-44444444444" + string(rune('0'+n)), TaskID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-55555555555" + string(rune('0'+n)), TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: created, LessonOrder: n})
	}
	p.PlanDigest, _ = DiagnosticPlanDigest(p)
	r := DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{IdempotencyKey: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", RequestHash: "sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc", Plan: p, BindingRevision: 1, BindingDigest: b.BindingDigest, BindingGoalCode: "go.backend", BindingDirectionCode: "backend", BindingCreatedAt: created}
	if ValidateDiagnosticPlanRecord(r) != nil {
		t.Fatal("valid")
	}
	for _, f := range []func(*DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord){func(x *DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) { x.BindingGoalCode = " Goal " }, func(x *DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) { x.BindingDirectionCode = "BACKEND" }, func(x *DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) {
		x.BindingDigest = "sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd"
	}, func(x *DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) { x.BindingRevision = 2 }, func(x *DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) { x.BindingCreatedAt = x.BindingCreatedAt.Add(time.Second) }, func(x *DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) { x.IdempotencyKey = "bad" }, func(x *DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) { x.RequestHash = "bad" }} {
		bad := r
		f(&bad)
		if ValidateDiagnosticPlanRecord(bad) == nil {
			t.Fatal("corrupt accepted")
		}
	}
}
